per_article_summaries: Liberty Media CEO Derek Chang says F1 chiefs are "working overtime" to come up with contingency plans for the series' Middle Eastern races. F1 was forced to call off its April doubleheader in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia as a result of the US-Israeli war on Iran.

Former F1 TV presenter Will Buxton has called out McLaren's strategy. Buxton claims that the Woking outfit has repeatedly made strategic errors. Lando Norris had been leading the race at the Miami International Autodrome. But, unfortunately for the reigning drivers' champion, McLaren performed a successful undercut.

Oscar Piastri has confirmed changes to his personal team ahead of the 2026 F1 season. Mark Webber is still Piastri's manager but has stepped away from trackside role. Pedro Matos and Emma Murray will join the 25-year-old at the track.

Former Formula 1 driver Karun Chandhok says Ferrari's upgrades left a lot to be desired. Chandhok believes McLaren and Mercedes will not be worried by Ferrari's updates. Kimi Antonelli won the Miami Grand Prix for Mercedes.

Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad has said that it has still not sunk in that he is racing in Formula 1. The 18-year-old driver secured a full-time F1 seat with Red Bull's sister squad after just one season in Formula 2. He currently sits 12th in the drivers' standings behind his team-mate Liam Lawson in 10th.

Lewis Hamilton posted a video to social media celebrating the city of Miami. The seven-time world champion can be seen racing a Ferrari Testarossa. The video embraces the visuals of the 1984 TV show Miami Vice, but more importantly, the video game Grand Theft Auto.

F1's 11th team has tried to make a rapid off-track impact in Miami. F1 branding in general was almost impossible to escape in Miami. Cadillac carved out its own space by taking over Jungle Plaza in the Miami Design District. The team also presented a limited CT5-V Blackwing F1 Collector Series car.

Guenther Steiner says there is no excuse for Aston Martin's poor start to the 2026 season. The Silverstone outfit entered the 2026 season with a new power unit partnership with Honda. But the high expectations from inside and outside the paddock were not met. Aston Martin sits last in the constructors' standings with zero points.

F1 agreed to a number of energy deployment tweaks to allow drivers to push harder in qualifying. Full effect of those changes has yet to come to light at circuits that are trickier for energy recovery than the stop-start Miami circuit. F1 stakeholders have already agreed in principle to go further for 2027 with an increase in power output from the combustion engine.

Red Bull's Max Verstappen will make his GT3 debut at the Nurburgring 24 Hours. The Dutchman is considering a move away from Formula 1 in 2026. GT3 architect Stephane Ratel says Verstappen is drawn to the category because it offers him a chance to make a difference.

Guenther Steiner has criticised the Miami Grand Prix stewards. Steiner claims that a time limit should be introduced for post-race penalties. Several incidents were under investigation by the stewards following the race. Max Verstappen and George Russell for causing a collision, Charles Leclerc for leaving the track multiple times on the last lap, and Leclerc for driving his car in an unsafe condition.

2025 F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin hopes that her Formula 1 test with Mercedes will open the door to more opportunities in the championship. The French driver joined the Mercedes Junior Team in 2024 when she entered the all-female racing series. After winning the championship in 2025, she was promoted to the role of development driver at the Brackley outfit.

Kimi Antonelli has won back-to-back races this season. The 19-year-old is now 20 points clear of Mercedes team-mate George Russell. James Hinchcliffe says Russell could end Antonelli's winning streak at Canadian Grand Prix.

Sergio Perez says Cadillac is 'in a massive hurry to find performance' Mexican has been battling with Aston Martin-Honda's Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll. Cadillac has been slowest in the pitlane in the first two races of the season.
